ruleBookInfo.author: @js:(function(){var m=String(src||'').match(/作者：\s*([^<\n]+)/);return m?m[1].replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g,''):'';})()
ruleBookInfo.lastChapter: @js:(function(){var T={'1':4,'2':8,'3':32,'4':64};var bk=(typeof book!=='undefined'&&book)?book:{};var bu=String(baseUrl||'')+'|'+String(bk.bookUrl||'');var m=bu.match(/[?&]uxt=(\d)/);var c=m?m[1]:'';if(!c){var ty=Number(bk.type||0);c=(ty===4)?'1':((ty===32)?'3':((ty===64)?'4':'2'));}try{if(book) book.type=T[c]||8;}catch(e){}var m2=String(src||'').match(/最新章节：\s*([^<\n]+)/);return m2?m2[1].replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g,''):'';})()
ruleBookInfo.name: .info_box h1@text

ruleToc.nextTocUrl: @js:(function(){var T={'1':4,'2':8,'3':32,'4':64};var bk=(typeof book!=='undefined'&&book)?book:{};var bu=String(baseUrl||'')+'|'+String(bk.bookUrl||'');var m=bu.match(/[?&]uxt=(\d)/);var c=m?m[1]:'';if(!c){var ty=Number(bk.type||0);c=(ty===4)?'1':((ty===32)?'3':((ty===64)?'4':'2'));}try{if(book) book.type=T[c]||8;}catch(e){}return '';})()

searchUrl: @js:var CID={'小说':2,'有声':3,'漫画':4,'视频':1};var mode='小说';try{var saved=source.getVariable();if(saved){var parsed;try{parsed=JSON.parse(saved);}catch(e){parsed=saved;}var selected=(parsed&&typeof parsed==='object')?parsed.mode:parsed;if(CID[selected]){mode=selected;}}}catch(e){}'https://uxxtv.com/?c=search&wd={{key}}&cid='+CID[mode];
